check_config.repair_record: Repair the record so it parses
check_config.repair_record_verify: Repair the record so it parses as TOML
check_config.correct_entry: Correct or remove the entry the message names
check_config.no_checks: declares no checks, so nothing ran
check_config.no_checks_fix: Name the project's checks under [check], or run akmon init to set them up
check_config.scope_fix: Run it inside a git work tree
check_config.check_table_ok: [check] declares {{count}} check(s), each a command that splits into arguments
check_config.check_table_ok_fix: Keep every [check] entry a command the project can run

nothing_to_do.fix: Nothing to do until a matching file changes

not_installed.message: `{{command}}` is not installed or not on PATH, so the check did not run
not_installed.fix: Install `{{command}}` in the project's environment or change the command under {{target}}

failed.fix: Fix what the command reported above, or change its configuration in the project

scope_error.git_unrunnable: cannot list the files changed against HEAD: git cannot be run ({{reason}})
scope_error.git_failed: cannot list the files changed against HEAD: `{{command}}` exited with status {{returncode}}

problems.not_table: [check] must be a table of named commands
problems.bad_entry: [check].{{name}} must be a command string or a table with `command`
problems.bad_files: [check].{{name}}.files must be a non-empty list of glob patterns
problems.unsplit_command: [check].{{name}} command does not split into arguments: {{error}}
